name: thesispartner
description: ThesisPartner — plateforme web de suivi de thèse

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @thesispartner/types && npm run build -w @thesispartner/validation
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @thesispartner/api" "npm run dev -w @thesispartner/web"
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis mailpit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @thesispartner/api && npm run typecheck -w @thesispartner/web && npm run typecheck -w @thesispartner/ui
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @thesispartner/api && npm run test -w @thesispartner/web
scripts.test:integration: node infrastructure/scripts/ensure-test-database.mjs && node infrastructure/scripts/migrate-test.mjs && npm run test:integration -w @thesispartner/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @thesispartner/api && npm run build -w @thesispartner/web
scripts.db:generate: node infrastructure/scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm exec -w @thesispartner/api -- prisma generate
scripts.db:migrate: node infrastructure/scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm exec -w @thesispartner/api -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node infrastructure/scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm exec -w @thesispartner/api -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: node infrastructure/scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm exec -w @thesispartner/api -- prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:seed:demo: node infrastructure/scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm exec -w @thesispartner/api -- tsx scripts/seed-demo.ts
